headline: Approval of a four-story, seven-unit building at 57 St. Lawrence Street, and a recommended rezoning of 87 High Street to B3 downtown business.
summary: The lot would be split in two, and the new building's seven garage spaces would be reached from St. Lawrence Place. Staff set conditions, including utility authorization letters and a certification of appropriateness from the historic preservation board. At 87 High Street, the applicant's representative said the rezoning would allow income-producing uses needed for the tax credit program. The city council makes the final decision on the rezoning.
decisions: Recommended to City Council adoption of the zoning change and height overlay for 87 High Street, 4-0 in the roll call.
Approved a waiver allowing a 16-foot drive aisle at St. Lawrence Place instead of 24 feet, 4-0.
Approved the site plan for 57 St. Lawrence Street, 4-0.
Adopted the written decision and authorized the chair to sign the approval letter for 57 St. Lawrence Street, 4-0.
discussion: 87 High Street zone change: A member said the change seemed reasonable, since the parcel looked like an anomaly on the map. Staff said the historic status makes the extra height allowance unlikely to be used.
Historic status of 87 High Street: A member asked whether the historic status covers the additions. The answer was that it covers the whole building, including two additions.

Driveway width at St. Lawrence Place: Members said the 16-foot drive matches the existing gravel road. The applicant's team said about 21 to 22 feet of pavement before the building lets cars turn into the garages.
Design of the 57 St. Lawrence building: A member praised the window variety and the varied shapes of the facade. The design team said the roof decks are set back toward the center of the building.
